_what: Screening markers: which MGnify catalogue should this sample be profiled against? `b` lists EVERY catalogue the species occurs in, not the one its genome came from — a species in three catalogues rules out the other sixteen and must be able to vote for all three.
_caveat: A verdict with no exclusive support is not a verdict. Species shared across catalogues raise every one of them; only abundance from species exclusive to a catalogue distinguishes it. Measured: a vaginal sample dominated by cosmopolitan Lactobacillus scores human-gut, human-oral and human-vaginal alike, with 0% exclusive support for any — that is the honest answer, and a coarser or finer database does not change it. Separately, 41% of the merged genomes carry no GTDB species name and are not markers at all, so soil, marine and marine-sediment are under-represented by an unknown amount.
